text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went shopping for training 
supplies with Daitaku Helios—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Let's do this nano~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~â 'Sup, Ines~! Are you, like, on 
the clock right now?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you two! Hallo-hallo~♪ Are you two 
interested too, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "The Carrot Cake Festival"!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All-you-can-eat limited-time carrot cake! 
There are a whole... twenty varieties!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat!?!? All-you-can-eat at Kikagen??? 
For real!?
choice_data_list:
"Limited time only" really is tempting, 
huh.

"Limited time only" really is tempting, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I... toootally get you!! So true!! It's 
super rare since you can only eat it right 
now!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And there are 20 different kinds...!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer!! We've totally gotta go for it 
now, right?!”

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ehhh!!
choice_data_list:
We've got upcoming races to think about, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you're right!? If I squish it 
normally, it's game over!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Limited time makes me cry... And 
the only way to meet them is to go right 
rn~~~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about that one? The 
limited-time petit four takeout set!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
With this portion size, I can enjoy the 
limited-time special without overdoing it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Isn't that totally fine? Like, so 
totally fine it's not even funny!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Plus, petits fours are definitely 
Insta-worthy!! Ines is a god! Love you to 
bits~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, Daitaku Helios uploaded a ton 
of cute petit four photos to her 
Umastagram."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hellll yeaaaah☆ Completed the set, now 
putting my fave on repeat! Foo~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Party of two, right this way~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Mmm☆ Super blissfuuul~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, everything is super 
yummicous~~~~! Forget my cheeks melting 
off, my whole face just fell off~~~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Seeing you eat with such relish 
makes me so glad I showed you the way♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Daitaku Helios devoured the 
limited-edition carrot cake to her heart's 
content...!
